screen.note: Screening never accepts. Gate thresholds use the same accuracy logic with looser margins: improvement floors are multiplied by (1-margin) and regression ceilings by (1+margin), so borderline proposals become screen_pass. Verdicts are only screen_pass or screen_fail; screen_fail is a rejection, screen_pass proceeds to the official tier-s run. Privacy failure is always screen_fail. Synthetic suite and accuracy proposals only.

privacy.note: Privacy cannot be disabled; every candidate dataset x seed must set privacy_passed=true.

not_measured: Spark executor / JVM heap and RSS (driver process RSS only)
